newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares gain on bonus issue expectations.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares gain on bonus issue expectations.

text.p: Shares at Qatar's unofficial stock market gained about one percent in the week to Thursday buoyed by strong buying interest on expectations that some leading firms may announce bonus share issues, brokers said.

"The market saw a continued high level of activity and several top names saw dramatic increases," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, senior treasury and investment manager at the Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ).
The CBQ's 18-share index jumped 1.24 points to 125.41.
Shakarchi said this reflected a 25 percent rise in the market since the index was launched at 100 points in June 1995.
In the week 10 shares rose and seven were steady. The only loser was Qatar Insurance Co, which shed five riyals to 660.
Market leader Qatar National Bank rose 10 riyals to 620 and Qatar Navigation extended the previous week's gains, adding another 20 riyals to 770.
CBQ and Qatar General Insurance shares gained five riyals each to 350 and 565 respectively.
Doha Bank Ltd ended the week one riyal higher at 283 and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar and Qatar Cement each closed three riyals higher at 222 and 313 riyals respectively.
Qatar Cinema was one riyal up at 183.
Qatar Flour Mills also gained one riyal to 310 and Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company added half a riyal to 54.50.
